title: Berlin Pride festival attack leaves one dead, 17 injured
summary: A vehicle mowed down a crowd at the Berlin Pride festival on Saturday, killing one person and injuring 17. The suspect, identified as Abdul Ballout, was shot dead by police during a nationwide manhunt. Police claim Ballout was an Islamist and were seeking his arrest. The attack prompted grief and solidarity with the LGBTQ community. One witness reported seeing Ballout rush at officers with a knife before he was shot.
summary_points: A vehicle mowed down a crowd at the Berlin Pride festival, killing one person.
17 people were injured in the attack.
The suspect, Abdul Ballout, was identified by police as an Islamist and was sought for arrest.
Ballout was shot dead by police during a nationwide manhunt.
Police claim Ballout had a knife when he was shot.
